title: MathRecords: search and verification software for mixed van der Waerden numbers
description:
Search and verification software for mixed van der Waerden numbers w(j+2; 2j, t1, t2), together with the lower-bound colourings, the SAT refutations and the replayed DRAT proof objects that independently re-derive five terms of the OEIS sequences A217005, A217007, A217058, A217059 and A217236.

These values are not first determinations. A217058 a(12), A217007 a(7), A217059 a(9) and A217236 a(4) were first computed by M. Ochocki (Zenodo preprint, June 2026, doi:10.5281/zenodo.20572598), and A217005 a(19) by S. Karki (U(t)-Mathazine 9 (2024), 34–39). All five agree with the values derived here; what this work adds is a second derivation by a different method and a machine-checked proof of every upper bound.

Lower bounds are explicit colourings, checkable against the definition by a standard-library-only program that never invokes a SAT solver. Upper bounds are SAT refutations: the search space is split into cubes, each cube's refutation is replayed to s VERIFIED under drat-trim, and the cube set is separately proved exhaustive by a composition proof that is itself replayed.

Terms re-derived: A217058 a(12) = 57, A217005 a(19) = 52, A217007 a(7) = 68, A217059 a(9) = 74, A217236 a(4) = 84.
